verdict.rationale: Mixpanel supports ingesting historical/bulk data via Warehouse Connectors (syncing from Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, Postgres) and has a general import/ingestion API implied by its event JSON model, but the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of a dedicated bulk 'Import API' for historical event backfill or migration from another analytics tool. missing for 10: explicit historical/bulk import API docs, guidance on importing from other analytics platforms (e.g., Amplitude/Segment migration), and confirmation of backdated event timestamp support.
